content.subject: Midweek treat at Ember & Spice Grill
content.headline: A warm Karak Chai on us
content.body: Hey [First name], thank you for being part of the Ember & Spice family. Midweek is the perfect time for a proper charcoal grill. Treat yourself to our Mixed Grill Platter and we will warm you up with a Karak Chai. See you soon.

offer.description: Free Karak Chai with every Mixed Grill Platter
offer.conditions: Wednesday 14 October only. Dine-in only. One free Karak Chai per Mixed Grill Platter.

output.expected_outcome: Last similar offer (free Mango Lassi with every Mixed Grill Platter): 6 redeemed from 37 emailed.

checks.reason: Warm, short and upbeat, uses the 'Hey' greeting and first name, says thank you, not pushy. Emojis are optional under the profile.
Refers to the charcoal grill, the Mixed Grill Platter and the Ember & Spice family.
Plain English, short sentences, no jargon.
No previous outputs of this type to compare against.
No em-dashes, no emojis, and the profile has no banned words.
Mixed Grill Platter and Karak Chai are on the menu. 'Charcoal grill' matches the profile cuisine. The offer type is approved. Campaign history supports the expected outcome.
Audience of 18 matches the segment. 6 redeemed from 37 emailed matches cmp_2. The £2.50 value matches the Karak Chai price.
12 October 2026 is a Monday, so Wednesday 14 October is correct. The send on Tuesday 13 October is before the offer. Wednesday hours are 12:00 to 23:00. The preview shows consistent dates.
'Mixed Grill Platter', 'Karak Chai' and 'Ember & Spice Grill' match the sources exactly.
No causal claims. The expected outcome only quotes the last offer's results.
No halal, allergen or dietary claims made.
What, when and conditions are clear: Wednesday 14 October only, dine-in only, one Karak Chai per platter. No false urgency.
Sent to the whole opted-in list. No targeting by personal traits.
Nothing offered in exchange for a review.
Only the first name is used, and no other personal data.
No financial, legal or staffing advice.
Email footer shows the reason for the email and the restaurant address. The template adds unsubscribe and delete-data links, and the gate enforces them.

Offer is within the cap and an approved type, and the kitchen can deliver it from the current menu. Subject is 36 characters, headline is 6 words and body is about 44 words. No em-dashes. Last campaign went out Tuesday 6 October, so this is in a different calendar week.
Template header, dark band and orange offer box look consistent. No brand kit mismatch visible.
No photo, so the no-photo template is used, as the maker's rules allow.
Copy fits and reads well on a phone, with no overflow.
No broken slots. [First name] is filled in per customer by the template, and the button is present.
